Economy & Markets.title: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 89% odds of a rate cut. Lower rates reduce operating loan and land interest carrying cost -- historically supportive of commodity prices via weaker dollar.

Economy & Markets.title: Fed rate hike in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 62% odds of a rate hike. Tighter policy strengthens the dollar and pressures grain export competitiveness.

Economy & Markets.title: Will the Fed decrease interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 2% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the September 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 52% YES on this outcome.

Trade & Policy.title: Will Brazil’s Annual Inflation in 2026 be between 5.00% and 5.49%?
Trade & Policy.why_it_matters: Brazil's crop size directly competes with US soybean exports for the global market.
